headline: Dollar approaches R$ 5.17, with foreign news and elections
summary: The dollar approached R$5.17 amid foreign news and elections. The Ibovespa fell 0.86% while New York exchanges also declined.
why: The Ibovespa is Brazil's main stock index, and the real's exchange rate affects foreign investors' returns on Brazilian assets.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: The benchmark index fell 0.86% in the session reported.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Foreign news and election uncertainty are cited as pressures on Brazilian assets, weighing on the real and the stock index.
